thread:
alex: ALERT: spike of 5xx/timeouts on hosted inference starting ~16:13 UTC. Customers reporting failed requests and long tails. Dashboards show auth-proxy 502 spikes + billing service 500/429 bursts. Opening warroom. @sre oncall please join.

jordan: On it. Which endpoints and regions?

alex: Affected: /v1/generate and /v1/chat in eu-west and us-east. Top customers: cust:3421, cust:9982, cust:acme-inc. Error sample from gateway logs: ```[16:13:22] gateway: upstream auth-proxy 502; request_id=abc123
[16:13:22] auth-proxy: validate_token failed -> billing-service 500 (rate-limit?)
[16:13:23] gateway: timeout waiting for inference backend -> 504; req=abc124
```

samira: I see auth-proxy traces showing repeated `500` from billing->token-verify. Billing returned `429` then `500` on token introspect. Looks like a burst throttle on billing tier check.

support-ops: We have 4 P1 tickets and a CSE on a bridge. Customers hitting it are seeing 5xx on all generate calls.

devon: Short mitigation we can try: enable auth-proxy local token cache and bypass billing rate checks for existing committed customers. I can push a patch. Command to flip config: ```kubectl patch deployment auth-proxy -n hosted --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/3/value","value":"local-cache"}]'```

jordan: Please coordinate with prod-safe. If we flip caching, ensure TTL is short and we emit metrics that show cache hit ratio.

support-bot: action:patch requested by devon. CI job started -> deploy/auth-proxy/patch-2026-03-17-1618. Rolling patch to eu-west first. :gear:

sre-bot: Alert suppression request: add temporary suppression for auth-proxy 5xx alerts to avoid alert fatigue while mitigation is in-flight. Will hold for 30m.

support-bot: deploy succeeded in eu-west at 16:28 UTC -> auth-proxy now using local token cache. Cache hit ratio ~72% and gateway 5xx rate dropped 80% in eu-west. us-east rolling in 2m.

alex: Good. Early telemetry shows latency drop and fewer client timeouts. We should still treat root cause as billing service throttling.

maria: Confirmed impact: committed customers in eu-west saw failures for ~15min window. Some pay-as-you-go customers also affected. We need to follow up with billing on the rate-limit policy and per-tenant throttles.

samira: Repro steps for postmortem: 1) use a valid token and hit the auth introspect endpoint repeatedly (100r/s) from single IP to simulate burst. 2) run `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://auth.internal/v1/introspect` in loop. Logs show: ```billing-service: POST /introspect -> 429 
billing-service: internal queue exhausted -> 500```

devon: Temporary rollback plan if patch regresses: revert env value to `remote` via same kubectl patch command. Keep quick rollback note in runbook.

jordan: Action items (assignments): 1) hotfix review & harden auth-proxy caching (owner: devon, due: 2026-03-18) 2) Billing rate-limit review and per-tenant backoff (owner: maria, due: 2026-03-20) 3) Add synthetic test to simulate token-introspect burst (owner: samira, due: 2026-03-22) 4) Runbook update: include `kubectl patch` snippet + rollback (owner: alex, due: 2026-03-19) 5) Alert tuning: separate auth-proxy 502 vs backend 5xx thresholds (owner: jordan, due: 2026-03-19)

support-ops: Noted and will notify impacted customers with timeline. CSE has list of customers to notify.

sre-bot: Created incident ticket INC-2026-00321 and linked this thread. Postmortem meeting scheduled Mon 09:00 UTC.

alex: Quick summary for postmortem: root cause = billing service throttling/token-introspect overload leading to auth-proxy returning upstream 502s and gateway timeouts; mitigation = enabled auth-proxy local token cache + temporary alert suppression; next steps = billing SLA review, synthetic tests, runbook updates, alert tuning.

maria: I'll coordinate with billing infra and send the initial RCA draft by EOD Monday.

samira: I'll attach reproducible curl script and logs to the incident ticket.

devon: Pushed follow-up PR to add more robust cache invalidation and metrics. Tagging reviewers.

jordan: Closing warroom for now — monitoring for 1h. Reopen if regressions. :thumbsup:
